description: ELK GROVE - Democrat Stephanie Nguyen's campaign for State Assembly today released poll results showing a clear 7-point lead for Nguyen over her opponent as the campaign enters its final months. The poll was conducted the first week of September by FM3 Research of likely voters in the 10th Assembly District. title: Stephanie Nguyen Ahead in Poll of Likely Voters
